description: Israeli monitoring organisations have tracked investigation outcomes in settler-violence cases for two decades and consistently find that only a small fraction of complaints lead to indictment.
energy_note: Filing is a formality, and everyone involved knows it.

description: Responding physically to an attack is very likely to result in arrest and a military court prosecution with a near-certain conviction. The asymmetry is the thing that has to be internalised.
energy_note: Being hit is free. Hitting back is years.

description: Families stop going to the outlying plots, stop letting children walk, stop grazing the far pasture. Land goes unused, and unused land is more easily declared state land.
energy_note: Retreating inch by inch, and losing the inches.

aspect: Which is the mechanism, not a side effect
description: Violence that goes unpunished transfers land more cheaply than any legal process. It does not need to be ordered by anyone to function as policy.

aspect: EXAMPLE - the UN's finding on who is standing there
description: In July 2025 the UN human rights office warned that escalating settler violence is carried out 'with the acquiescence, support, and in some cases participation, of Israeli security forces' - which is the mechanism by which the impunity in this issue operates.
